title: I built a free stock market game where you race an HMM trading algorithm with 100K USD of play money
author: Effective_Manager273
selftext:
Hi all. I've been building this on nights and weekends for a while and it's finally at the point where I want people to try to break it.

It's called InvestMuse. Everyone gets $100k in play money and there's a monthly leaderboard. You go long or short on anything in the universe (1,200+ stocks, crypto, commodities, metals, FX, indices) and you're ranked against the other players, five fictional fund managers with their own styles, and my own hidden Markov model algo that paper trades every day.

What you get for each asset:

\- a composite score built from 9 parts (regime, technicals, trend, support/resistance, fundamentals, sector comparison, news sentiment, momentum, chart patterns)

\- support and resistance from my own clustering method, chart patterns drawn on the chart, fibonacci, demand and supply zones

\- for US stocks, any KPI compared against other stocks with its monthly trend, refreshed when earnings come out

\- the last month of news scored by AI, and how closely the news tone actually tracked the price

\- the algo's daily trades and signals

If an asset you want is missing, type it in search and it's there the next day.

It's free, no ads, no card. I'm not selling signals and nothing on it is advice. It's a place to test your own ideas against a scoreboard -see why they worked or didn't-, create your own community, improve yourself.

Honest feedback wanted, especially on whatever is confusing in the first two minutes.

[https://investmuse.io](https://investmuse.io/)

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: if the HMM gets refit every day, check that the past regime labels don't get rewritten by the refit. otherwise the algo's history on the leaderboard looks smarter than what it actually traded at the time.

replies.author: Effective_Manager273
replies.body: hi thanks for the comment. trained models only see the data until 2023. after that all last bar states are being predicted by the model. previous bars' states are constant. so no look ahead and no repaint. would you like to have a try in our competition? you're more than welcome.

replies.author: Effective_Manager273
replies.body: you can also invite your friends of course

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: fair, if earlier states are frozen and only the last bar is live then it doesn't repaint. I'll sit the competition out for now but I'll keep an eye on the leaderboard.
